_about: Eight design skills selected by stars and reviews (02.10.2026). Clone repo with `git clone --depth 1` into scratchpad/skills/<dir>; entry is what the agent reads first; drive is how to run the skill without its own harness. Take slug/title/entry/drive for bakeoff.json from here.

skills.title: Anthropic · frontend-design
skills.drive: Read it fully; it has no other files besides the licence.

skills.title: UI/UX Pro Max
skills.drive: Read it fully; run its search/design-system scripts with python3 as its SKILL.md instructs to pick style, palette and typography; save the generated design system into your folder.

skills.title: OpenDesign
skills.drive: The repo is ~450 MB: never read it broadly, use targeted ls/grep. Follow skills/reference-design-contract and skills/design-brief, the craft/*.md rules they require, and pick one fitting system from design-systems/. Write the design contract (DESIGN.md) into your folder before building.

skills.title: Taste Skill
skills.drive: Read it fully; glance at the repo README for its siblings but let taste-skill govern. It is written for React/Tailwind: apply its rules to static HTML.

skills.title: Impeccable
skills.drive: Read it fully plus its reference files; apply its process (shape/craft, then critique/polish) as text guidance. Skip its scripts/impeccable launcher: it downloads a binary outside the output folder.

skills.title: Hallmark
skills.drive: Read it fully plus the references its design flow names; run its slop test after the build.

skills.title: Huashu Design
skills.drive: Written in Chinese: follow it, the pages stay in the brief's language. Where it asks a human to choose a direction, decide yourself as it recommends and record why in direction-approved.md.

skills.title: Google Stitch skills
skills.drive: The Stitch MCP server is not available: use the offline skills. enhance-prompt turns the brief into PROMPT.md; design-md and taste-design (plugins/stitch-utilities/skills/) produce DESIGN.md; then implement the pages exactly to that DESIGN.md as Stitch would.
